subject: Ops deep-dive & dedicated pool sizing — proposed slots
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@aurorapay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Ops deep-dive & dedicated pool sizing — proposed slots

Hi Nora,

Great to meet you and Samir on the call earlier — thanks for walking through AuroraPay's payment enrichment flow. Quick recap and next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Goal: Schedule a dedicated capacity sizing call to map throughput (QPS/requests per hour), tail latency SLOs, and expected sequence lengths so we can recommend a Dedicated GPU pool size and a pre-demo load profile.
- Prep for the sizing call: a short load snapshot (peak QPS, average tokens per request, concurrent users) and any network diagram showing where inference will be hosted.

I pulled a couple of windows that work for our ops and platform engineers:
- Monday, Jul 2 — 10:00–11:00 AM PDT
- Tuesday, Jul 3 — 2:00–3:00 PM PDT
- Wednesday, Jul 4 — 9:00–10:00 AM PDT

If none of these fit, tell me a few times that do and I’ll loop Ben (SE) and Karthik (Solutions) in. I’ve attached a short sizing template — filling the first tab with a sample hour of traffic is usually enough for our initial recommendation.

Thanks,

Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: redwood-sizing-template.xlsx (spreadsheet - 12KB stub)

From: Nora Patel <nora.patel@aurorapay.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Desai <samir.desai@aurorapay.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ops deep-dive & dedicated pool sizing — proposed slots

Hi Sofia — thanks for the clear recap. Monday 10:00 AM PDT works for Samir and me.

Quick answers to your prep items so Ben/Karthik can start thinking:
- Peak QPS: ~110 req/s during peak billing batch windows (we expect bursts up to ~160 req/s for short periods).
- Avg tokens per request: 220 tokens (mostly user-provided text + metadata).
- Concurrent inference sessions: typical steady state 30–40, spikes up to 250 during overnight reconciliation.

I’ll attach our network diagram and a sample hour export — these are redacted for PCI but should be enough. Can Ben and Karthik advise if there’s anything else we should include?

Thanks,
Nora
Director of Platform Engineering | AuroraPay
nora.patel@aurorapay.com

Attachment: aurorapay-network-diagram.pdf (pdf - 48KB stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@aurorapay.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ops deep-dive & dedicated pool sizing — proposed slots

Thanks Nora — good data to start with. I’m confirming Monday 10:00 AM PDT on my calendar. A few pre-call asks so we can prepare accurate configs: 

1) Sample payload size distribution (min/median/95th token count) — if you have percentiles that’s ideal.
2) Target 95th/99th tail latency SLOs for inference (in ms).
3) Any strict requirements around returning partial responses vs full generation-only (some customers prefer streaming).

I’ll bring a brief slide that maps approximate GPU types and pool sizing to your traffic bands and common quantization options we recommend. If you prefer, we can also run a quick synthetic replay during the call to validate latency numbers.

Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0123

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@aurorapay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Jul 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ops deep-dive & dedicated pool sizing — proposed slots

Hi Nora / Samir — confirming our slot: Monday, Jul 2 — 10:00–11:00 AM PDT. Calendar invite sent (link below). Agenda: 1) 15-min discovery recap and load review; 2) 30-min sizing exercise and recommended pool; 3) 15-min runbook and next steps (demo + provisioning timeline).

Prep checklist (upload to the shared drive before the call if possible):
- CSV with sample hour token distribution (if different percentiles available include them)
- Network diagram (thanks for the PDF)
- Any compliance constraints (data residency, redaction rules) that affect hosting

Link to invite: https://calendar.redwood.com/meet/sofia/ops-deepdive-20280630
HubSpot record: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/85642

See you on the call — I’ll assign roles on our side: Ben will lead the sizing exercise, Karthik will cover deployment options.

Best,
Sofia

From: Samir Desai <samir.desai@aurorapay.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nora Patel <nora.patel@aurorapay.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Jul 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ops deep-dive & dedicated pool sizing — proposed slots

Perfect — confirmed for 10:00 AM PDT. I uploaded a redacted sample_hour.csv to the shared drive and added a quick note about our peak window characteristics. We’re particularly sensitive to 99th percentile latency under burst — target is <= 350ms.

On the call we’d like to validate: expected warmup behavior, KV cache persistence, and what happens during autoscale events (how graceful the fallback is to a smaller pool). If you can include a short slide on fallback policies, that would help us decide on the min reserve.

Thanks — Samir
Senior SRE | AuroraPay
samir.desai@aurorapay.com
